cand.title: EUROGUSS Mexico 2027
cand.excerpt: Rank 4: medium evidence and direct Expo Guadalajara relevance; venue is committed, so current-edition accessibility is constrained and the lead is not an assumed open room block.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Verified commercially relevant organizer contacts: Gissella Palma, Sales Manager; Bernardo Staines, Representative in Mexico; Dennis Smith, CEO/Managing Director. Their published roles make them suitable for routing an accommodation-partnership enquiry and identifying the actual housing or group-travel buyer. None is verified as the hotel-contract signatory; no appointed housing intermediary was established.
findings.futureEdition: A genuine upcoming 2027 edition at Expo Guadalajara is advertised within the requested horizon. Exact activity dates conflict: the dedicated event homepage, contact page and English review say 17–19 November 2027; the parent organizer’s 2025 results release and official event LinkedIn profile say 16–18 November 2027, including a May 2026 promotional post. These are event dates, not article dates. Use November 2027 for prospecting, but leave verified start/end dates null until the organizer reconciles the discrepancy. Do not use the German EUROGUSS 2028 dates shown in the parent website navigation.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference: strong city/convention-hotel fit for the supplied 216-room Sheraton Guadalajara Expo, rather than a resort/incentive thesis. The hotel officially markets proximity to Expo Guadalajara, guestrooms, meeting venues, catering and planning support. Target exhibitor teams, international visitors and organizer-referred guests, plus small private briefings or hospitality functions. The exhibition remains at Expo; no full-event relocation, hotel buyout or room-night volume is evidenced. The supplied 216 rooms describe hotel inventory, not event demand.
findings.venueCommitments: Expo Guadalajara, Av. Mariano Otero 1499, Guadalajara, Jalisco, Mexico, is the publicly announced exhibition venue, not a competing hotel. This establishes the advertised venue, not access to its underlying signed contract. Historical 2025 functions used Hotel Barceló and Hotel Intercontinental. The English page titled Programme 2025 now explicitly advertises functions there on 18 and 19 November 2027, but archived agenda and Spanish programme retain October 2025 activities. Treat these as provisional/conflicted 2027 function listings, not verified hotel contracts or room blocks.
findings.historicalRotation: Documented physical host-city continuity, not destination rotation: 2018 pavilion at Fundiexpo in Guadalajara; planned 2020 edition canceled; 4–18 May 2021 Virtual Weeks; 28 February–2 March 2023 standalone fair at Expo Guadalajara; 15–17 October 2025 at Expo Guadalajara. The official site expressly describes an every-two-years cycle. Do not infer annual recurrence or a confirmed post-2027 edition.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Hotel sourcing status: unknown/unconfirmed, neither verified open nor verified closed. No organizer-published 2027 housing agency, room-block inventory, booking portal, room-night requirement, cutoff or accommodation RFP was established from reviewed material. Holiday Inn Guadalajara Select independently advertises a special EUROGUSS rate for 2027, but gives 16–18 November and does not establish organizer appointment or a contracted block. Exhibitor stand applications are exhibition-space sales, not hotel RFPs. Organizer referral and direct exhibitor/company travel procurement are proposed sales pathways, not verified purchasing arrangements.
findings.organizationStructure: Corporate trade-show organizer, not an association-owned congress or incentive programme: the event site names NürnbergMesse North America as organizer. Its corporate site identifies it as the North American subsidiary of NürnbergMesse GmbH. NürnbergMesse and partner PR1MA were named for the 2023 edition; that historical partnership does not establish PR1MA as the 2027 PCO or housing buyer. Global Foundry Show is a co-located/parallel event organized by Clúster de la Fundición, not an interchangeable event owner.
findings.competitiveLimitations: Barceló and Intercontinental have verified 2025 social-function relationships; an inconsistently updated English programme also names them for 2027. This creates a plausible relationship disadvantage, not proof of exclusive accommodation control. Holiday Inn Guadalajara Select is already marketing an event-specific rate. No sourced sold-out hotel, unmet demand, compressed availability or overflow requirement was found; do not label this an overflow lead.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact Gissella Palma first, copying Bernardo Staines, with a concise Sheraton guestrooms/meeting-space proposal. Ask them to reconcile 16–18 versus 17–19 November 2027, identify the accommodation decision-maker or any housing agency, confirm whether hotel partnerships and exhibitor/visitor referrals remain available, and clarify the 2027 status of Barceló/Intercontinental functions. Only after buyer confirmation request pickup/room-night needs, arrival/departure patterns, contracting timetable and permission for exhibitor introductions. Offer a site inspection; do not quote an assumed block or claim overflow.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: For the selected upcoming 2027 edition, the main exhibition venue is already announced, so pitching to host the exhibition is not an evidenced opportunity. Accommodation may remain independently accessible, but procurement openness and organizer referral access are unconfirmed. The named incumbent social venues may limit access to those functions; the mixed-edition programme prevents treating their 2027 commitments as settled. Historical 2025 business is not current inventory.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: pursue incremental 2027 accommodation and satellite hospitality, with longer-term relationship development for later cycles. Guadalajara venue continuity and explicitly biennial positioning support a recurring account strategy, but no post-2027 date, venue or sourcing window is verified. Earlier-cycle preferred-hotel consideration is a sales objective, not a published tender or commitment.
